answers: We are Fintech, a growing financial technology company serving mid-sized businesses. We want to grow without adding too much overhead, but our sales-to-delivery process is becoming harder to manage.
We have around 70 employees and our annual revenue is between $10M and $25M. Sales, operations and delivery teams are mainly involved in this process.

The main problem starts after sales closes a deal. Information is spread across HubSpot, Slack and email, and some important guidance is still with senior people, so affected projects can face around 2–3 days of delay and 10–15 hours of waiting or rework.

I can approve changes to this process, and our Head of Operations can lead the rollout with sales and delivery. The team is open to standardizing the process and using AI for guidance, as long as important client and pricing decisions still have human review.
